title: perseid.toml
description: perseid.toml: the SDKs to generate, and the OpenAPI spec they are generated from.

auto_merge.description: `true` makes `sdks.yml` enable auto-merge on the SDK pull requests, and on the release PRs they lead to: SDKs whose tests pass are merged and released unattended.

base_url.description: API base URL the clients default to.

csharp.description: The C# SDK, a NuGet package.

exclude.description: Operation ids left out of every SDK.

header_prefix.description: Prefix of the SDK's own headers, such as `{prefix}-retry-count`: the kebab-case `name` by default.

idempotency_keys.description: `true` when the API deduplicates POST requests by `Idempotency-Key`: the SDKs then send one with every POST, and retry them. Otherwise only POSTs given a key are retried.

internal.description: Also generates the operations marked `x-internal: true`.

java.description: The Java SDK, a Maven package.

metadata.description: Package metadata written into the manifests `perseid generate` creates.

methods.description: Method names by operation id, over the resource-style names.

name.description: Client name, in any form (`Acme`, `acme-api`, `Acme API`): the `AcmeApi` client, the `acme_api` and `acme-api` packages.

only.description: Operation ids to generate, leaving out every other operation.

overrides.description: Directory mirroring `templates/<lang>/…` and `runtime/<lang>/…` to override built-ins: `.perseid` by default.

pagination.description: Paginated list operations, detected from their query parameter and response shape.

python.description: The Python SDK, a PyPI package.

release.description: `false` leaves out the release-please files and the release workflow `perseid init` writes.

repo.description: Default repository of every SDK: `owner/name-{lang}` gives each its own (`{lang}` is the language: `typescript`, `python`…), `owner/name` holds them all in folders named after their language. Without it, the SDKs live next to perseid.toml.

round_trips.description: Also generates a test decoding and encoding sample JSON of every model, with `tests`.

sdks.description: The SDKs to generate. A language table only overrides the settings of a listed SDK.

source.description: The repository pushing the spec here with the hosted perseid App, which `perseid connect` adds: it gets Contents write on this repository, and needs no App itself.

spec.description: The OpenAPI document (3.0 or 3.1, JSON or YAML) generated from: a path relative to perseid.toml, where `perseid connect` pushes it from another repository, or an http(s) URL.

tests.description: `false` leaves out the tests generated with each SDK, one per operation.

timeout.description: Default request timeout, in seconds: 60 by default.

types.description: How values of some `format`s are typed, in every SDK.

typescript.description: The TypeScript SDK, an npm package.

untagged_unions.description: How unions decode objects that no rule tells apart.

user_agent.description: Prefix of the `User-Agent` header: the kebab-case `name` by default.

webhooks.description: Installs the Standard Webhooks signature verifier in every SDK.

base_url.description: API base URL this client defaults to, over the top-level one.

context.description: Values exposed to templates as `sdk.*`, over the top-level `[context]`.

exclude.description: Operation ids left out of this SDK only, on top of the top-level `exclude`.

header_prefix.description: Prefix of this SDK's own headers, over the top-level one.

methods.description: Method names by operation id, over the top-level `[methods]`.

package.description: Root namespace and NuGet package: `name` by default.

path.description: Output directory, relative to the repository the SDK lives in: the language's name, or the root of a repository of its own.

repo.description: `owner/name` of a GitHub repository to generate into, over the top-level `repo`.

round_trips.description: Also generates the round trips of every model, over the top-level setting.

description.description: One-line summary: `{name} API client` by default.

repository.description: URL of the source repository of the SDKs without a `repo`: the `origin` remote of the repository holding perseid.toml by default. An SDK with a `repo` names that one.

Pagination.description: How a list operation pages, as `x-pagination` on an operation or `[pagination]` in perseid.toml. Exactly one of `cursor`, `page` or `offset` names the query parameter selecting the page; response values are dotted paths of JSON property names. A perseid.toml rule without `operations` uses `has_more`, `total_pages` and `total` only in responses that have them.

cursor.description: Query parameter taking the cursor of the page.

first_page.description: Number of the first page, 1 by default.

has_more.description: Boolean telling whether more pages follow.

item_cursor.description: Field of the last item that is the next cursor, e.g. `id` for `starting_after`.

items.description: The array of items: `data` by default, else the response's only array of objects.

next_cursor.description: Cursor of the next page in the response.

offset.description: Query parameter taking the index of the first item.

operations.description: perseid.toml only: operations this rule must apply to, instead of every matching one.

page.description: Query parameter taking the page number.

total.description: Total number of items, for offset pagination.

PushedFrom.description: A repository allowed to push the spec, by id: a repository recreated under its name has another.

repo.description: `owner/name` of the repository pushing the spec, for people: left out with `perseid connect --private`.

target_id.description: The id of the repository holding this file: a copy of it elsewhere grants nothing.

Types.description: How values of some `format`s are typed.

uuid.description: `format: uuid` values: `uuid::Uuid`, `UUID`, `Guid`... (`typed`, the default), or strings, for an API whose "uuid" values are not all UUIDs, as one would fail decoding.

UntaggedUnions.description: How a union decodes an object when several variants are objects that neither a discriminator nor the constants and required properties they declare tell apart.

oneOf.description: The variant whose required properties are all present and which knows the most properties, the first declared on ties.
The language's UUID type, TypeScript's `string` aside.
